title: Scaling changes magnitude, not the SCS+C factors
caption: Exact multiplier 0.0001999969482421875; no offset. All ten fitted C values are identical at the tested scales. Spectral shape alone cannot verify calibration.

title: Aligned geometry, with unresolved terrain provenance
caption: North is up on the common 10cm grid; images sampled every sixth cell. Self-shadow means cos(i)<=0, not a complete cast/canopy-shadow mask. Terrain resampling does not create new independent detail.

title: Timestamp interpretation changes the model, not its provenance
caption: Solar geometry uses the existing approximate UTC package function at scene center for sensitivity. Local-time interpretation puts the sun near the horizon and can trigger neutral fallbacks; that is not evidence of successful correction. No case was selected for looking better.

title: The red instability is denominator cancellation
caption: At row1178,col1533, cos(i)=0.3482566 and C=-0.3472517 leave denominator0.00100496 and factor309.9168. Positive illumination does not prevent cancellation. Huber moves the pole; it does not remove it.

title: Resolved support reduces extremes; robust fitting alone does not
caption: Native supports are shown separately. Stabilized coverage is98.96% of raw, including existing geometry losses; no gain was capped. The cosine alternative is numerically extreme near local self-shadow and is not recommended.

title: Red reflectance on each native support
caption: Identical grid, north up, every sixth cell. Common raw99th percentile controls display only; analytical extremes are retained. White is unsupported/missing. Candidate calibration remains unverified.

title: Where factors and exclusions occur
caption: Display factor limits0.5-350 do not clip analysis. Pole-adjacent regions become unsupported; the rule does not make new measurements. Unsupported boundaries can create selection bias and are tested using identical common pixels.

title: Matched spectra: first identity in each recorded class
caption: One outcome-blind lexicographic polygon per class, on identical common pixels. Curves are ten discrete optical bands, not a continuous hyperspectral measurement. Representative curves cannot establish physical accuracy.

title: Smaller absolute variance is not uniformly better consistency
caption: All157 polygons use the same142,656 common memberships. Compare CV and spectral angles alongside absolute variance: multiplicative dimming can lower variance without improving relative spectral consistency.

title: Illumination dependence and class variation can move differently
caption: Partial associations control recorded class and a linear spatial plane across independent polygon means. Spatial autocorrelation/nonlinear vegetation structure remain. Reducing correlation alone does not establish more accurate reflectance.

title: No established identification benefit from stabilized SCS+C
caption: Package classifier uses polygon-disjoint3fold validation, training-only scaling and fixed C=1. Intervals bootstrap fixed out-of-fold predictions by class/identity; they exclude model/coefficient/site uncertainty. Only5 deciduous polygons: one changed prediction shifts balanced accuracy by5 points.

title: Class separation is mixed, not universal
caption: Distances, overlap and permutation evidence are descriptive of one labeled flight. Package spectral_separability uses499 permutations, independent polygon units and equal discrete-band weights; significance within a branch does not test a correction gain.

title: Aggregation and support are part of the scientific comparison
caption: Means reproduce the earlier P169 aggregation; medians are a sensitivity analysis, not selected for a better score. Native-support contrasts and the old71.7% historical score use different masks and cannot be attributed solely to correction.

title: Changes and extreme-factor locations
caption: Signed differences are candidate reflectance on stabilized support;99th-percentile display bounds do not alter measurements. Right: sampled positions with historical red gain>10;star marks actual native maximum at row1178,column1533. The threshold10 is descriptive only, not the eligibility rule.
